narrative.synopsis: The hidden Zeus returns not merely to survive but to free the siblings Cronus swallowed. With Metis’ help, Cronus is forced to disgorge them, creating the Olympian alliance.
narrative.openingSituation: Zeus has survived the deception that saved him as an infant.
narrative.centralConflict: Cronus still contains the older children and still holds Titan power.
narrative.resolution: The swallowed siblings emerge and stand with Zeus.
narrative.outcome: A family revolt against Cronus can now begin.
